source_facts: private_block/argument.rs:902-908 and private_attention's counterpart define the endpoint slots as eq(tau) * (A_plane - endpoint_plane)
private_block/layout.rs:474-498 SLOT_KINDS marks them Standalone, so the sum they prove is zero and the published scalar is the CFS mask term alone
shared_coordinates.what_that_means: no blinding source is shared: every commitment's reserved mask pairs, proximity rows and pads are its own, so the non-data block of the joint generator matrix is block diagonal and joint == sum is a THEOREM about that block structure -- the rank below is computed anyway, and the controls show it moving when a blinding source IS shared

per_capture.what_is_NOT_covered: the two channels are linked NONLINEARLY by the terminal identity; no linear model sees that link.  The Merkle roots, the leaf salts and the authentication paths are hash objects and are not in this model either.

claim_weight_outside_its_reserved_pair.direction: the pair step of the reduction (H-pair) fails -- two claims now share a reserved pair -- so the stage refuses; the Rust verifier would already have panicked on the row-span assertions in pcs.rs, which is why this cannot be reached by a real receipt.
findings: a commitment's reduction hypothesis (H-pad / H-pair / H-prox) fails, so the joint reduction does not apply and its ranks are not a disclosed dimension
claim_weight_outside_its_reserved_pair.what: A's claim 0 given a weight on row 215, which belongs to another claim's reserved pair

one_mask_row_removed.direction: UP, in the marginal AND in the joint: A discloses 256 Fp on its own, so the sum rises with the joint and they stay equal; stage 4 fails on the other arm, a part exceeding its expected public value.
findings: the parts recomputed through the joint code path differ from stage 2's
a part exceeds its expected public value -- A: 256 > 0
one_mask_row_removed.what: A[213] removed: the commitment has one blinding row fewer, so its singleton group's non-data block is 2 generators against 1 column

one_pad_fewer_than_the_distinct_opened_c.direction: the pad step of the reduction (H-pad) fails, so the ranks below are no longer a disclosed dimension at all and the stage refuses rather than reporting a number.
findings: a commitment's reduction hypothesis (H-pad / H-pair / H-prox) fails, so the joint reduction does not apply and its ranks are not a disclosed dimension
one_pad_fewer_than_the_distinct_opened_c.what: A's pad count set to 245 against 246 distinct opened columns

shared_blinding_source.direction: UP.  Neither commitment discloses anything on its own -- the marginals do not move at all -- but once the two blinding rows are one unknown, a combination of the two commitments' group vectors cancels on every non-data coordinate and survives on the data rows, so the joint rises by 256 Fp per such direction while the sum of the parts stands still. This is precisely the case the hard-coded stage 4 could not see.
findings: the joint disclosed dimension 260 differs from the sum of the parts 4
shared_blinding_source.what: A[213] and H[280] -- one reserved mask row of a singleton opening group in each commitment -- made the SAME unknown
